meta.name: The Death and Life of Bobby Z
meta.description: A DEA agent provides former Marine Tim Kearney with a way out of his prison sentence: impersonate Bobby Z, a recently deceased drug dealer, in a hostage switch with a crime lord. When the negotiations go awry, Kearney flees, with Z's son in tow.
meta.slogan: To live a life of his own, he has to die first.
